notes.title: Version 1.08 has been released!
notes.content:
We've just published version 1.08 with the following changes:

[list]
  [*]Online fix (teleporter)
  [*]Camera fix (dual cranes)
[/list]

We'll be watching the following thread for bug reports and any other issues:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/592480/discussions/0/1751273165172752329/

Or email issues to bugs@foamswordgames.com.

Thanks!

notes.title: Version 1.07 has been released!
notes.content:
We've just published version 1.07 with the following changes:

[list]
  [*]General optimization (framerate, memory, load smoothness)
  [*]AI character triggers adjusted
  [*]Fix for rare button prompt conflicts (bike unlock, stereo unlock)
  [*]Save state fixes (dungeon buttons)
  [*]Fixed conversation that warped bike to invalid location
  [*]Animation fix (rock face)
  [*]Fix for errors regarding dancing enemies online
  [*]Fix for tracking of "Tour de Penfurzy" trophy
  [*]Z-fighting fixes
  [*]Pause screen closing on controller removal
  [*]Minor text fixes
[/list]

We'll be watching the following thread for bug reports and any other issues:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/592480/discussions/0/1658943116244244090/

Or email issues to bugs@foamswordgames.com.

Thanks!
